description: Retrieve comprehensive runtime & debugging metrics: CDP counters (JSHeapUsedMB, Nodes, JSEventListeners, LayoutCount, ScriptDuration), Core Web Vitals (TTFB, FCP, LCP + target element, CLS + shifting elements, INP, TBT + long tasks), Resource bottlenecks (slowest & render-blocking URLs), DOM/A11y health (liveDomElements vs blinkRetainedNodes, detachedOrUncollectedNodes, max depth, duplicate IDs, missing alt/labels), runtime console errors, and automated diagnostic warnings.

bringToFront.description: Activate and bring the tab to front before probing Web Vitals so Chromium paints FCP/LCP on background-opened tabs (default: false)

collectGarbage.description: Attempt V8 garbage collection before reading metrics to distinguish true detached DOM leaks from uncollected garbage (default: false)

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

forceGC.description: Alias for collectGarbage: trigger V8 garbage collection before reading metrics (default: false)

includeDomHealth.description: Collect DOM depth, duplicate IDs, and accessibility health metrics (default: true)

includeResources.description: Collect resource bottleneck metrics (slowest & render-blocking URLs) (default: true)

includeWebVitals.description: Collect Core Web Vitals (TTFB, FCP, LCP, CLS, INP, TBT) (default: true)

timeoutMs.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds for the metrics probe
